caseName: Banco Nacional de Cuba v. Sabbatino
caseNameFull: Banco Nacional de Cuba v. Sabbatino, Receiver
attorneys: John A. Wilson for movant Compañía Azucarera Vertientes-Camaguey de Cuba. Victor Rabinowitz and Leonard B. Boudin for petitioner. Joseph Slavin for Sabbatino, and O. Dickerman Williams for Farr et al., respondents.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 372 U. S. 905, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit. Further consideration of the motion for leave to substitute Com-pañía Azucarera Vertientes-Camaguey de Cuba in place of Peter L. F. Sabbatino as a party respondent is postponed pending a hearing on the merits of the case.
